reason: 112 implemented tools cover explicit GTM v2 operations, composed inspection/release workflows, and client status; source handlers call the Tag Manager API rather than stubs.
exposure: Default --groups=all registers all 18 groups plus always-registered check_client_status. --groups=web and explicit comma-separated groups narrow registration. TAG_MANAGER_READ_ONLY=true retains tool exposure but rejects mutations.
limitations: Offline extraction registers exact source-extracted function signatures/docstrings using FastMCP 4.1.0; full server imports and GTM operations were not executed. Raw tools/list artifact is from the reconstructed offline registration, not a connected upstream server.

GTM resource body arguments intentionally use unrestricted Dict[str, Any] schemas; discovery resource fields are not exposed as MCP input constraints. Live API behavior, permissions and availability were not verified.

Insights pagination silently stops after 50 pages per collection, so claims of complete enumeration have that cap; summarize_container treats any live-version retrieval exception as no published version, including permission/network failures.

tools.title: Update Zone
tools.description:
Update a zone in a workspace.

The zone you send replaces the stored one, so read it with
get_zone first and send the whole thing back with your edits
applied. Omitted fields are cleared, not preserved.

fingerprint.description:
Fingerprint from a previous read. When given, the
update fails if the zone changed in the meantime.

tools.behavior: Calls Google Tag Manager v2 accounts.containers.workspaces.zones.update using validated ID-derived paths and rejects writes in read-only mode.
tools.exposure: Registered with --groups=all (default) or group 'zones'; excluded from --groups=web.

tools.name: delete_zone
tools.title: Delete Zone
tools.description:
Delete a zone from a workspace.

This affects the workspace only. The zone stays in production until
a version without it is published.
tools.behavior: Calls Google Tag Manager v2 accounts.containers.workspaces.zones.delete using validated ID-derived paths and rejects writes in read-only mode.
tools.exposure: Registered with --groups=all (default) or group 'zones'; excluded from --groups=web.

tools.name: revert_zone
tools.title: Revert Zone
tools.description:
Undo a workspace's changes to one zone.

Restores the zone to the state of the container version the
workspace was branched from, leaving the workspace's other changes
alone.

fingerprint.description: Fingerprint from a previous read.

tools.behavior: Calls Google Tag Manager v2 accounts.containers.workspaces.zones.revert using validated ID-derived paths and rejects writes in read-only mode.
tools.exposure: Registered with --groups=all (default) or group 'zones'; excluded from --groups=web.

tools.name: check_client_status
tools.title: Check Client Status
tools.description: Check that the Tag Manager client is configured and can authenticate.
tools.behavior: Reports initialization, credential resolution, read-only state and scopes; accessing client.service may resolve credentials and build the Tag Manager v2 client.
tools.exposure: Always registered.

review.summary: Manage server clients and transformations, find entities by name, and summarize container workspaces and live versions.
